subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the official Cloudflare AI Gateway plugin support Workers AI as a narrow explicit onboarding mode now, or should that work wait for the broader REST/catalog bridge design?
rationale: The endpoint protocol, model identity, and catalog ownership affect the public provider contract; the two related open issues propose overlapping but different long-term boundaries.

options.title: Define a narrow Workers AI onboarding mode
options.body: Add a plugin-owned explicit Workers AI mode using the existing onboarding surface, with a documented endpoint and `@cf/...` model contract, while keeping the broader bridge work separate.

options.title: Fold it into the broader bridge design
options.body: Defer implementation until the owner of the multi-provider catalog and REST migration defines one coherent Cloudflare AI Gateway model contract.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow Workers AI onboarding mode
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned explicit Workers AI mode using the existing onboarding surface, with a documented endpoint and `@cf/...` model contract, while keeping the broader bridge work separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the original Cloudflare AI Gateway onboarding proposal and its public setup boundary.
